data.text: Before we choose, how about a shared limit of 10 tons each this month? That leaves 50 tons, so next month starts at 100 whether natural replenishment happens or the remaining fish double. We’d each earn $10,000 while preserving that opportunity every month. Catching 19 each would leave only 5, risking a next-month stock of just 10 tons. I propose we all agree to 10 each, review the revealed catches afterward, and adjust future limits together if needed. John, would you agree?
